mapper.select: SELECT s.stock_name AS "name", s.stock_code AS "code", a.quantity AS "shares", a.purchase_amount AS "buyPrice", a.avg_price AS "avgBuyPrice" FROM asset a JOIN stock s ON a.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT s.stock_name AS "name", so.quantity AS "shares", so.order_price AS "sellPrice", a.avg_price AS "buyPrice", (so.order_price - a.avg_price) * so.quantity AS "profit", ROUND(((so.order_price - a.avg_price) / a.avg_price) * 100, 2) AS "profitRate", so.updated_at AS "tradeDate" FROM stock_order so JOIN stock s ON so.stock_code = s.stock_code JOIN asset a ON so.stock_code = a.stock_code AND so.account_id = a.account_id WHERE so.account_id = #{accountId} AND so.transaction_type = 'SELL' AND so.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY so.updated_at DESC
